skill_name: Compare and contrast the Pros and cons of using renewable energy sources.
workflow: Renewable energy sources have many advantages compared to fossil fuels. They are generally more sustainable, as they can be replenished much faster than non-renewable sources such as coal, oil and natural gas. Renewable energy sources also create fewer emissions, making them better for the environment.
